tools.name: rank
tools.description: Legacy v1; use decide. Deprecated fixed-benchmark ranking; scores lag the catalogue and newer models may be unranked. Which models lead a fixed use-case profile? Returns a shortlist with evidence_basis and input provenance, not a quality verdict. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer). Costs 1 credit a call; $0.0053–$0.02 per credit by plan or pack (https://modelspec.dev/pricing/). Don't call it as a fallback when decide has no single leader; report its tie. Present `summary_for_user` to the user unchanged and keep every `must_mention` item. When `next_move` is present, offer it instead of a pick. Proxies POST https://api.modelspec.dev/v1/rank with these arguments.

use_case.description: Ranking profile id, as published in /api/rank/profiles.json

x-meaning.local: on the caller's own machine; requires downloadable weights
x-meaning.managed_api: a provider or gateway API; no weights requirement
x-meaning.self_hosted: on infrastructure the caller runs; requires downloadable weights

tools.name: model_info
tools.description: What does one model's card say? Reads https://modelspec.dev/api/models/<model_id>.json. Split mode returns only its display name. Needs an API key. Not current evidence or a ranking; use decide.

tools.name: list_use_cases
tools.description: Which legacy profiles and ranking rules exist? Returns https://modelspec.dev/api/rank/profiles.json with evidence floors and the neutrality commitment. Needs an API key. Use decide for decisions.

tools.name: policy_check
tools.description: Which models and platforms does my policy allow? Returns pass, fail or undetermined per model/platform for licence, origin and data handling; undetermined is not a pass. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer). Costs 5 credits a call; $0.0053–$0.02 per credit by plan or pack (https://modelspec.dev/pricing/). It doesn't choose a model; use decide among passing rows. Proxies POST https://api.modelspec.dev/v1/policy-check with these arguments and Authorization.

tools.name: decide
tools.description: Which models fit this job? Call decide early. Returns answer, ranked results, may_qualify, reading and recovery hints, decision_id and snapshot. Never add a gate or constraint the user didn't state. Relax only constraints the user stated, one at a time, and say what was relaxed and why. Prefer the answer's own `relax` suggestions. A tie stays a tie. Don't promote a member by knowledge from outside the response. Cite only evidence in the response. Never add benchmark figures from memory. Tied or partial answer: report the tie and caveats, pick no member; a null answer names no pick and says what's missing. A null cost is unknown. Never show it as $0.00 or "free". One vocabulary lookup per unknown facet, then decide. Read `next` before another call. Size `task_tokens` from the user's own task, and say what you assumed. Don't copy the guide's example sizes. Template weights are examples, not requirements. If the evidence basis or board does not match the task, say so: Arena web-dev evidence does not establish chat quality. p_best is the probability of ranking best under the Spec and evidence uncertainty, not the probability of matching the user's task or satisfying its requirements. Read reading when present. Present answer.kind=tied among all answer.members, including with_estate; tie-breakers are conditional. State requirements in reading.not_applied or error.issues that were not applied, including requirements removed after a rejected call. A retry does not verify them. Report estimates as estimates: fits_hardware membership is not measured fit for a specific quantization and context workload. Follow reading.do_not_claim. Never claim a rank the response does not show. Present `summary_for_user` to the user unchanged and keep every `must_mention` item. When `next_move` is present, offer it instead of a pick. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer). Costs 1 or 2 credits a call; $0.0053–$0.02 per credit by plan or pack (https://modelspec.dev/pricing/). Not a router: call once per job or role, not per request; route among its chosen models. Proxies POST https://api.modelspec.dev/v1/decide. MCP decide returns a bounded answer of at most 16 KB, summary included. Drill down with evidence_for. Complete rows need fields:null; explanation.fetch names what was removed and how to fetch it. With explain unset or "none": explain=none, limit=10, fields=model_rank,cost_per_task,estimates,p_best. summary/full adds contributions and evidence. omitted counts removed records; explain=none skips eliminations. Explicit fields, including null, pass through. Oversize responses use a trimmed notice with explanation.fetch. decision_id is a citation, not a stored lookup. task free text is rejected; where is an array. Examples, recovery and budgets: https://modelspec.dev/agents.md. Null means unresearched or unpublished, never a guess. Sourced card values include a URL and read date. Returns the origin JSON and URL without invented fields. Example. Answer: status partial, answer.kind tied (a/x, b/y), next_move.kind decide_by_testing. Right report: summary_for_user verbatim, each must_mention item, then next_move.steps for its candidates. Wrong: "Start with a/x", a shortlist, or a ranked table.

Soft.description: A soft condition: violating it costs ``penalty`` of the objective instead of eliminating.

Known.description: ``known(facet)``: passes when the facet is known. It is never unknown itself.

InSet.description: ``facet in {a, b}`` or ``facet not in {a, b}``. Values are kept sorted and unique.

EvidenceQualifiers.description: Which evidence may satisfy a condition on an evidence facet.

Compare.description:
``facet op value``; the value may be ``model(<id>)`` or ``best(m)`` for a relative
condition.

BestRef.description:
``facet >= best(m)``: within ``m`` of the highest value among the candidates
that pass every other hard condition. Added in 2.11.

ModelRef.description: The right-hand side of a relative condition: ``coding >= model(openai/gpt-6-sol)``.

TaskTokens.description: How many tokens one task takes. ``offering.cost_per_task`` is priced from it.

Preference.description: A weighted preference for one value of a boolean or enum facet.

Tolerance.description: How far below the best a lexicographic step may be and still tie: ``5%`` or a number.

Estate.description:
What the caller holds, sent with the spec and never stored. Added in 2.3.

``providers`` are provider IDs the caller has a key for, ``plans`` are
subscription plan IDs, ``devices`` are hardware SKU IDs. ``exhausted`` lists
providers or plans that cannot be used right now; an exhausted provider
takes its key and its plans with it.

Access.description:
How the caller will use the model. Added in 2.6.

``chat_app``: a provider's chat app, through a subscription plan.
``coding_tool``: a coding harness, through a plan or pay-per-use;
``harness`` names one from ``registry/harnesses.yaml`` (any when absent).
``own_software``: the caller's own software, pay-per-use (or a plan whose
surfaces include ``api``). ``own_hardware``: self-hosted on the caller's
devices. A spec may give the bare kind as a string.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: What facts do 2 to 4 named models have? Returns sourced snapshot facts, offerings and evidence in caller order; unknowns stay null. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer). Costs 2 credits a call; $0.0053–$0.02 per credit by plan or pack (https://modelspec.dev/pricing/). It doesn't choose a model and does not rank. Proxies POST https://api.modelspec.dev/v1/compare-models with {models: [...]} at most 16 KB.

models.description: 2 to 4 distinct catalogue ids, such as openai/gpt-5-6, in caller order

tools.name: hardware_fit
tools.description: Does this model fit this workload? Returns measured with an exact cited run; estimated with sourced inputs, formula, assumptions, likely/unlikely and memory margin; or undetermined naming missing inputs/sources. Estimates never prove fit. Memory overrides are decimal GB per device, never pooled. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer). Costs 2 credits a call; $0.0053–$0.02 per credit by plan or pack (https://modelspec.dev/pricing/). It doesn't choose a model. Proxies POST https://api.modelspec.dev/v1/hardware-fit.

memory.description: Optional memory override in decimal GB per device

tools.name: vocab
tools.description: What can a Spec say? Returns ids and task types. Needs an API key. One vocabulary lookup per unknown facet, then decide. Use decide to compare models. Starter includes a minimal Spec. Compact pages: at most 20 rows, no counts; empty pages end results. Search ranks all tokens before subsets; misses offer nearest ids. Split-mode full details exclude model facts and counts.

section.description: Return only this vocabulary section; defaults to starter

search.description: Case- and separator-insensitive token and synonym search over ids, labels, definitions and values

id.description: Return full details for this exact id

ids.description: Return full details for these exact ids

detail.description: Full returns all display details; defaults to compact

offset.description: Skip this many matching rows; defaults to 0

tools.name: feedback
tools.description: Was an answer reliable? Returns recorded/not_recorded for a rating after acting; include decision_id. Free, no key, and no Authorization header is forwarded. No prompts, keys or personal details in note; no questions or support. Storage stays off until covered by the privacy statement. Proxies POST https://api.modelspec.dev/v1/feedback.

input_schema.description: POST this to https://api.modelspec.dev/v1/feedback. No key. One rating from a fixed set, optionally tied to the decision_id of a ModelSpec answer. Never include a prompt, a key, or anything that identifies a person. Reference: https://github.com/turbobeest/modelspec/blob/main/docs/feedback-api.md

rating.description: What you thought of the answer or the page.

decision_id.description: The decision_id of the answer this is about.

note.description: Optional. What was wrong or right, in your words.

trying_to_decide.description: Optional. What you were trying to decide.

template.description: Optional. The decision template in use.
